title: GPT-4o joins the text API
summary:
GPT-4o joined the text API, web-search defaults got clearer, and vision requests gained working examples.

Added `openai-large` as a GPT-4o chat model with vision support. The existing `openai` option remains on GPT-4o-mini, and its model-list description now says so.

Text requests using web search now get a search-specific system prompt when the caller does not provide one. The default prompt also no longer suggests adding Pollinations links to responses.

The API documentation now shows how to send image URLs or base64-encoded images for analysis with GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, including a Python example.

highlights.title: GPT-4o joins the model list
highlights.text: Use `openai-large` for GPT-4o chat and vision requests; `openai` remains the GPT-4o-mini option. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
